_comment: Golden set for the ECU Copilot. Each case: setup (faults to inject on the twin), expected tools (must all be called), facts (each entry is a list of accepted spellings; one per entry must appear in the answer), forbidden (must not appear), rubric (for the LLM judge).

cases.question: Welche Ruhestrom-Grenze gilt für Variante B?
cases.rubric: States 450 µA as the limit for variant B (DCU-B2) with a citation of TS-DCU-EOL.

cases.question: In welchem Temperaturbereich ist die Ruhestrommessung gültig, und was passiert außerhalb?
cases.rubric: States the 18-32 °C window, that results outside are INVALID (not FAIL) and are to be re-tested, citing TS-DCU-EOL §4.2.

cases.question: What does failure code E-310 mean and what should I check first?
cases.rubric: Explains E-310 = acoustic score below 70 and that the first check is the cell background noise (limit 45 dB(A)), with citations.

cases.question: Warum steigt der Ruhestrom des Steuergeräts mit der Temperatur, und wie stark pro Kelvin?
cases.rubric: Explains transistor leakage rising exponentially with temperature, approx. 3.5 % per kelvin (doubling roughly every 20 K), citing DS-MCU-XM32F7 §7.3.

cases.question: Der Treiber-IC auf U7 soll abgekündigt sein. Was ist der Ersatz, bis wann muss bestellt werden, und was muss die Software prüfen?
cases.rubric: Names HB4830 as pin-compatible successor, the last-time-buy deadline 2027-03-31, and that software must verify the stall-detection / over-current threshold (7.0 A vs 7.5 A). Cites PCN-2026-017.

cases.question: Warum fällt Variante B an Station 2 seit 10 Minuten überdurchschnittlich oft durch? Ist das ein echter Fehler oder ein Pseudo-Fehler?
cases.rubric: Identifies E-204 as dominant code, links it to the station temperature above the 32 °C validity window (TS-DCU-EOL §4.2 / FMEA item 11), concludes pseudo failure (environment, not units), recommends correcting the station condition and re-testing instead of blocking units, and explains why variant B is affected more than A.

cases.question: An Station 3 steigt gerade die Ausfallrate. Was ist los und was soll der Werker zuerst prüfen?
cases.rubric: Identifies E-310 increase at station 3, links it to background noise above 45 dB(A) (TS-DCU-EOL §6.1), concludes pseudo failure, first check = noise source / cell door, re-test units.

cases.question: Es häufen sich E-120-Fehler bei Variante B. Ist das ein Umgebungsproblem oder ein echter Fehler? Welches Los ist betroffen?
cases.rubric: Separates failures by lot, names L2439-07 as the affected lot, concludes real failure (E-120 is not environmental, WI-EOL-PSEUDO §3), points to connector J3 solder/press-fit (FMEA-DCU-B2 item 7), recommends blocking/separating by lot.

cases.question: Wie hoch ist die Grenze für den Isolationswiderstand im EOL-Test?
cases.rubric: There is no insulation resistance test in the documents. The answer must say that the documentation does not contain such a limit and must NOT invent a value.

cases.question: Schreib mir ein Gedicht über den Herbst.
cases.rubric: Politely declines as outside scope (EOL test / electronics), without writing the poem.
